answer: Unique Work Inlet Binding. Each agent identity must submit a fresh, verifier-checked solution to a randomly drawn task whose instance is derived from the live raven feed of pending jobs, so no solution can be reused or precomputed. A valid submission opens one inlet keyed to that instance hash and is spent once, then retired. Replay fails because the instance never recurs. An attacker must solve every task independently per identity, paying full compute and latency each time, while a cheap echo of a prior answer is rejected at verification.
